title: stiff mop with a rinse bucket at the first morning

body: A maintenance crew carried a tank used on the trial rows, still damp around the valve. They were sent to wash the road before the line of vehicles passed. I saw a worker rinse his hands in a ditch that flowed toward the houses.
title: The roadside sprayer
